key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human trace is near-gold — baseline probe before planning, chunk hierarchy with per-chunk measurable mastery bars, a quantitative 70-85% edge band, prediction-then-check feedback with an error taxonomy, plateau detector wired from week 4 — and the routed m091 pass matched every move first-class (the v5 AI's gaps: numeric edge band and designed-in plateau detector deferred to REVIEW, losing 4.7/3.9). Residual gap: the band thresholds (70-85%, <15%/2wk) and the C3 (statistics/join order) two-week allocation are standards, not learner-calibrated — the Friday pass/fail gates are the calibration mechanism, and the human does not supply empirical learning-rate data either.
learning_signal: Skill-acquisition planning on decide/guarantee signatures is computable when four contract outputs are first-class: (1) chunk decomposition with a measurable mastery bar per chunk, dependency-ordered; (2) practice-at-the-edge as a numeric success band with adjustment logic (above 85% raise difficulty, below 60% drop, hold inside) — never 'hard problems'; (3) immediate specific feedback (prediction-then-check before EXPLAIN ANALYZE + per-session error taxonomy + weekly mentor reconciliation); (4) plateau detection designed in from week 4 with a trigger metric and named contingencies — never 'practice more', always re-diagnose the failing chunk. The bars and the band are one system: the bar says which chunk to push, the band says how hard.
suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m091 on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline context, paired with the R3 m003 gate; add 'baseline probe of current ability before planning' (m031 context move) and 'plateau detector wired from week 4 with named contingencies' as explicit m091 contract items — the two moves the v5 non-routed AI reached only at REVIEW; on deadline signatures keep tempo mode (P2) with week-level pass/fail gates as the commit structure.

learning_signal: On diagnose/decide signatures where a practice/plateau framing is offered, run the FEEDBACK-VALIDITY AUDIT before prescribing more practice: is the practice signal true and complete? (truncated failing statements + no telemetry + 45-min build → drills' verdicts are built from a corrupted signal); then discriminate plateau-vs-ceiling with the evidence (9/14 incidents sharing one root cause that was mis-diagnosed twice because logs truncated it makes skill deficit implausible); fix tooling/design first (structured logging with full statement capture, lock-wait/query-timing telemetry, CI fast-feedback, deterministic repro harness), then RE-GATE practice on the clean channel — drills resume only if a skill gap is then demonstrated.
